theme: Fuel is the only thing you cannot make more of
title: GEO Longitude Station-Keeping: Dead-Band on a Budget
strategies: do-nothing: never correct (band thresholds set beyond the box, so the box-exit check fires first); the evaluator's own weak reference, reproduces score ~0.1

tight symmetric proportional control: correct every deviation back to the box center immediately, ignoring both burn-efficiency timing and the drift's sign; tightest position control but burns on almost every step at the unfavorable average efficiency and runs out of fuel early

asymmetric dead-band sized from the systematic drift rate and burn-window period, recentering far on the side AWAY from the drift direction after each burn, and waiting (up to a computed safe patience) for the efficient window before burning unless the 0.95*W safety margin forces an earlier reaction
same asymmetric-dead-band recipe as strong (no further refinement in this ladder; RL is expected to push past it, e.g. by also compressing the safety margin or adapting patience per remaining fuel)
